selected_script.angle: Stop scraping sticky baked-on grease from an oven door edge with a plastic spatula because it only drags the oil into gritty brown streaks; use EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser foam on the same spot, wipe, and show the cleared glass edge.
selected_script.hook: I tried scraping this oven-door grease off, but it just smeared into gritty streaks.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a greasy oven door glass edge with baked-on brown oil. A hand uses a plain plastic spatula and damp cloth to scrape, but the grease drags into gritty streaks instead of lifting.
timeline.3-6s: The same scraping continues on the same stain. The camera stays tight as the oily residue spreads wider, the cloth looks stained, and the hand pauses in visible frustration from the extra effort.
timeline.6-10s: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser enters naturally beside the oven door, label visible. The user sprays foaming cleaner on the same greasy streak, lets it cling briefly, then wipes with a gray cloth to reveal a clear glass edge. End with the cleaned section held next to the still-greasy untouched edge for credible before-after proof and a casual voice CTA: Check it out for tough kitchen grease.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a normal American kitchen, natural light, no polished studio look. Use the provided product reference image as the exact product identity: EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser in a white molded plastic trigger spray bottle with short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, molded finger grooves on the side, rounded rectangular lower body, glossy orange front label with dark navy bottom band, EcoPure Lab logo near the top, Heavy Duty Degreaser title, Foaming Action subtitle, small stovetop image panel, and 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml capacity cue. Preserve the product color, label, shape, material, proportions, logo position, nozzle structure, and visible bottle details; do not change it into a different cleaner and do not invent accessories or packaging.

Timeline inside this single continuous video: 0-3s: Start in an extreme close-up, not a product shot, on a greasy oven door glass edge with baked-on brown cooking oil and sticky residue near the metal trim. A hand tries a familiar ordinary method: a plain plastic spatula and a damp cloth scraping at the stain. The grease does not lift; it drags into cloudy brown streaks and small gritty clumps. 3-6s: Continue the exact same failed method on the same stain. Keep the camera tight and handheld as the hand scrapes harder and wipes again, making the oily smear wider, leaving residue lines on the glass and staining the cloth; show believable effort and a short frustrated pause, with no exaggeration. 6-10s: The EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser bottle enters naturally from the side of the oven door, label briefly readable and facing camera. The user sprays foaming degreaser directly onto the same smeared grease; show real foam clinging and loosening the oily film without magical instant cleanup, smoke, sparks, or exaggerated chemical effects. The hand wipes with a gray cloth using realistic pressure, revealing a clear glass edge. Finish with a credible before-after proof in the same frame: the cleaned strip beside a small untouched greasy edge, plus the bottle standing nearby with its orange and dark navy label visible. End with a casual spoken-style CTA only, such as: “Check it out for tough kitchen grease.”

Strict negatives: no UI, no subtitles, no captions, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no floating icons, no poster headline, no before-after graphic split screen, no invented accessories, no product drift, no magical cleanup, no exaggerated foam flood, no disinfectant or bacteria-killing claims, no unreadable dense label recreation, no scene splitting, no separate videos.
